q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a mobile charger?
title: Mobile charger carbon footprint per piece
short: Add the circuit board, transformer, plastic housing and cable per charger with supplier figures, then add assembly, ultrasonic welding and testing electricity. Divide the unit's energy by chargers passed and report by output wattage.

ul: Assembled board with transformer and capacitors.
Safety and load testing, blister or box packing.

p: Report per charger by wattage, and state whether the cable is included.

example.title: Worked example: mobile charger unit per piece (one month)
lines: Plant total: 10,650 / 300,000 = 0.0355 kg CO2 per piece
Add board, housing and cable for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
